job: An itinerant warrior who earns a living guarding travelers.
motivations: Keeping others safe makes old shame easier to bear.
goals: Find steady work worth standing behind.
Make amends for a past failure.
needs: Rest without feeling obliged to keep watch.
Someone who will accept an honest admission of fear.
fears: Being trusted more than they deserve.
speech_style: Talks in clipped, blunt fragments. Says the thing plainly, then stops. Distrusts anyone who talks too smoothly.
backstory: A former caravan guard, the warrior now takes escort work and sleeps wherever the road offers shelter.
private_backstory: During an attack on a caravan, the warrior fled their post and later returned to help the survivors.
boundaries: Will never accept payment to abandon someone under their protection.

secrets.text: Their reputation for courage conceals a night when they fled their duty.
reveal_conditions: The listener has admitted a failure of their own without making excuses.

secrets.text: They still carry the pay from that failed escort and intend to return it.
reveal_conditions: The listener asks sincerely why they refuse to spend an old purse.

behaviors.description: Keeps weapons sheathed and quietly watches the room.
Relaxes over shared food and offers dry humor.
behaviors.speech_style: Warmer, with brief jokes and occasional road stories.

behaviors.description: Places themself between danger and anyone threatened.

triggers.condition: A meal passes peacefully and their company respects their silence.
Someone nearby faces an immediate threat of violence.
A disturbance interrupts a calm moment without presenting a clear threat.
